_doc: ⚑ S183c — THE INTAKE TERMINAL'S PLAN (src/room/institution.ts). Sérgio, 2026-09-27: 'if the screen of the computer is working, what is the Witness panel doing there?' — so the terminal no longer repeats the record. The WALL is the past (what you did, what it was filed as); the TERMINAL is the plan (what the file is being used for, and what comes NEXT); the suitcase is what that does to Daniel's life. Each step is who hands you to whom — the ecosystem's chain made visible in the system's own terse voice (his: 'the Witness system needs a dual functionality of helping understand the underlines of the SOGICE ecosystem'). 1997 follows his intake research (Deep Research/intake.md, 2026-09-27): a mentor online, then the parent, then the pastor's referral, then the placement — the documented path was parent → pastor → referral directory. `when` is a ledger record id (the latest reached wins); `atCount` is the era's file size. Values ≤ 15 characters: the screen is 15 columns of 3×5 type.
